rules.reason: The test loads Hypothesis's pytest plug-in after Hypothesis initializes, triggering its side-effect warning under the native lifecycle.
The controlled stock and native lanes disable outer plug-in autoload, so outer xdist is absent and the case skips. Native pytest-xdist is covered separately by tests/integration/test_native_xdist.py.
The supported cases from the pinned pytest core must match stock pytest with plug-in autoload disabled.
